description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the Tensor class in the TensorFlow Java API, verifying tensor creation, data manipulation, shape handling, datatype correctness, and error cases.

classes.name: TensorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the functionality of the Tensor class in TensorFlow Java API.

methods.name: createWithByteBuffer
methods.description: Tests the creation of tensors from ByteBuffer with various data types.

methods.name: createFromBufferWithNonNativeByteOrder
methods.description: Verifies tensor creation from buffers with non-native byte order.

methods.name: createWithTypedBuffer
methods.description: Tests tensor creation using typed buffers like DoubleBuffer, FloatBuffer, etc.

methods.name: writeTo
methods.description: Verifies writing tensor data to ByteBuffer and other buffers, including byte order conversions and error conditions.

methods.name: scalars
methods.description: Tests creation and properties of scalar tensors of various primitive types.

methods.name: nDimensional
methods.description: Verifies creation of tensors of various shapes and dimensions, including nested arrays.

methods.name: testNDimensionalStringTensor
methods.description: Tests creation and copying of 2D string tensors.

methods.name: testUInt8Tensor
methods.description: Tests creation and copying of a UINT8 tensor.

methods.name: testCreateFromArrayOfBoxed
methods.description: Checks that creating tensors from boxed array types raises an error.

methods.name: failCreateOnMismatchedDimensions
methods.description: Ensures tensor creation fails when input array dimensions are inconsistent.

methods.name: failCopyToOnIncompatibleDestination
methods.description: Validates that copying tensors to incompatible shapes or types throws exceptions.

methods.name: failCopyToOnScalar
methods.description: Tests that copying scalar tensors to incompatible destinations raises an error.

methods.name: failOnArbitraryObject
methods.description: Ensures creation of tensors from unsupported object types fails.

methods.name: failOnZeroDimension
methods.description: Checks that tensors cannot be created with zero in any dimension.

methods.name: useAfterClose
methods.description: Verifies that using a tensor after closing results in an exception.

methods.name: eagerTensorIsReleasedAfterSessionIsClosed
methods.description: Tests that eager tensors are released after the session is closed.

methods.name: fromHandle
methods.description: Tests creation of tensors from an existing native handle.

methods.name: gracefullyFailCreationFromNullArrayForStringTensor
methods.description: Tests that creating string tensors from null arrays throws an exception.
